# BeanBox
Kyiv’s Data-Driven Specialty Coffee Subscription

---

## The Problem & Solution
- Specialty coffee subscription service based in Kyiv [f1].
- Founded by a roaster and a growth marketer [f8].
- Rapid traction: 400 paying subscribers in 6 months [f5].
- Combines artisanal roasting with growth marketing.

---

## Traction & Unit Economics
- 400 paying subscribers acquired in 6 months [f2].
- Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) ≈ 7,200 EUR [f4].
- Calculation: 400 subscribers × 18 EUR/month [f3].
- Subscription price: 18 EUR/month [f3].
- Churn rate and CAC are currently being optimized.

---

## The Team: Complementary Expertise
- Co-founder 1: Master Roaster (Technical/Product Quality).
- Co-founder 2: Growth Marketer (Acquisition/Retention).
- Structure balances artisanal quality with scalable growth [f23].
- Critical for early-stage DTC brands [f23].

---

## Market Opportunity: Kyiv’s Specialty Shift
- Ukraine's coffee market estimated at USD 300–400 million [f10].
- Strong post-2022 shift towards home brewing [f13].
- Kyiv hosts dense landscape of specialty roasters [f11].
- Competitors: Kyiv City Roastery, Kolo Coffee, Idealist [f15].
- Validates high consumer demand for premium local coffee.

---

## The Bottleneck: Capacity Constraint
- Current roastery is operating at/near full capacity.
- Inability to fulfill increased demand or scale efficiently.
- Hypothesis: Second roastery required to unlock scale [f22].
- Note: Capacity utilization data available in diligence.

---

## The Solution: Second Roastery
- Direct investment in production infrastructure.
- Enables scaling beyond the current 400-subscriber limit.
- Mitigates risk of contract roasting (quality, margin) [f7].
- Specific use of funds: Open a second roastery [f7].

---

## Competitive Landscape
- Competitors: Kyiv City Roastery, Kolo Coffee, Idealist [f11].
- Differentiation: Curated subscription vs. retail-only.
- 18 EUR/month offers volume discount vs. cafe pricing [f16].
- Cafe pricing: 80–200 UAH (approx. 2–5 EUR) per cup [f16].
- Existing expectation for recurring delivery in Kyiv [f20].

---

## Business Model: Recurring Revenue
- Price: 18 EUR/month [f3].
- Recurring revenue stream from day one.
- Gross margin per subscription: To be disclosed in diligence.
- Simple, predictable unit economics.

---

## The Ask: 300k EUR
- Raising 300,000 EUR [f6].
- Use of Funds: Second roastery construction & equipment [f7].
- Goal: Unlock capacity to scale subscriber base.
- Runway: Projected [X] months post-investment (diligence).

---

## Why Now?
- Validated demand (400 subs in 6 months) [f5].
- Team ready to scale (Roaster + Marketer) [f23].
- Infrastructure is the only remaining barrier to growth.
- Optimal moment to invest in production capacity.

---
